info.name: Get tenants associated with a given user

params.name: user_id
params.description: Id of the user to retrieve all associated tenants for.

params.name: limit
params.description:
The number of accounts to return 
(defaults to 20, maximum value of 100)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Continue the pagination with the next cursor

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of user tenant associations.

info.name: Add a User to Multiple Tenants

params.name: user_id
params.description: The user's ID. This can be any uniquely identifiable string.

items.docs:
This endpoint is used to add a user to
multiple tenants in one call.
A custom profile can also be supplied for each tenant. 
This profile will be merged with the user's main 
profile when sending to the user with that tenant.

info.name: Remove User From All Associated Tenants

params.name: user_id
params.description: Id of the user to be removed from the supplied tenant.

items.docs: Removes a user from any tenants they may have been associated with.

info.name: Add a User to a Single Tenant

params.name: user_id
params.description: Id of the user to be added to the supplied tenant.

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: Id of the tenant the user should be added to.

items.docs:
This endpoint is used to add a single tenant.

A custom profile can also be supplied with the tenant. 
This profile will be merged with the user's main profile 
when sending to the user with that tenant.

params.name: user_id
params.description: Id of the user to be removed from the supplied tenant.

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: Id of the tenant the user should be removed from.

items.docs: Removes a user from the supplied tenant.
